title: Abbas meri shimr se
body:
abbas meri shimr se chadar to dila do
balwe mein khule sar hoo zara parda bana do
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt lagi aag mai kis kis ko sambhalun
sajjad ko jalte huwe qaimon mein nikalo
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
paband e rasan shaam ko tayyar khadi hoo
mehmil pe zara aa ke mujhe aap bitha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman mein lagi aag na jal jaye sakina
masooma ke daaman ki zara aag bujha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sehme huwe masoomo ko neend aayegi kaise
ek baar zara aa ke inhe aap sula do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
maa akbar o asghar ki mere saath hai kehti
sughra ko madine mein ye paigham pahuncha do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
waaqif mai nahi shaam ki raahon se ay bhaiya
ek baar mujhe shaam ka rasta to bata do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ajre risalat diya ummat ne tere baad
abbas ye zewar mere haathon mein pehna do
abbas meri shimr se...
<<DIVIDER>>
sardar ko gham tera hai aulaad se pyara
kehta hai shab e roz mere bakth jaga do
abbas meri shimr se...
author: Sardar
